# South Banks Towns (formerly Coastal Towns)
> A pre-construction waterfront townhome community by Deco Homes and Opus Homes at 1110 Lakeshore
> Road East, Mississauga, within the 177-acre Lakeview Village master plan. Originally marketed as
> Coastal Towns / Coastal Townhomes; renamed South Banks per multiple recent sources.

## Key Facts
- Builders: Deco Homes & Opus Homes
- Former name: Coastal Towns / Coastal Townhomes
- Location: 1110 Lakeshore Road East, Mississauga, ON — Lakeview Village
- Home types: 120+ three-storey freehold townhomes
- Price range (reported, varies by source): $500,000s to ~$1,000,000
- Launch: Fall 2026 (reported) — Completion: 2028
- Last updated: 2026-09-06

## Source
Independent information resource. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Deco Homes or Opus Homes.
Figures are researched snapshots, several conflicting across sources — confirm current details
before purchasing.
